passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nDavid is the author.\r\nDavid speaks in this passage.

passages.text: I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
passages.sermon:
David speaks these words.
David gives thanks to God.
David uses all his heart to thank God.
David sings praises to God.
David sings before other gods.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ אוֹדְךָ֥ בְכָל־ לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David bows down toward God's holy temple.
David gives thanks to God's name.
David thanks God for His loving devotion.
David thanks God for His faithfulness.
God has exalted His name above all things.
God has exalted His word above all things.
passages.original: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־ הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־ שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־ חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־ אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־ כָּל־ שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David called to God for help.
God answered David.
God made David bold.
God gave strength to David’s soul.
passages.original: בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃

passages.text: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God over all the earth.
All the kings of the earth will thank the LORD.
They will hear the words that come from the LORD’s mouth.
When they hear these words, they will give thanks to the LORD.
passages.original: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ מַלְכֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃

passages.text: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
passages.sermon: The LORD is great in glory.\r\nPeople will sing about the ways of the LORD.\r\nThey will praise Him because His glory is very great.
passages.original: וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is exalted.
The LORD is very high.
The LORD sees the lowly.
The LORD pays attention to humble people.
The LORD knows the proud from far away.
The LORD keeps His distance from those who are arrogant.
passages.original: כִּי־ רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃

passages.text: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and attentive.
He cares for those who are in need.
If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve my life.
You protect me from the anger of my enemies.
You stretch out Your hand against my foes.
Your right hand saves me.
passages.original: אִם־ אֵלֵ֤ךְ׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַי תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is faithful.
The LORD will complete His purpose for me.
The LORD’s loving devotion lasts forever.
LORD, do not abandon the work of Your hands.
passages.original: יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־ תֶּֽרֶף׃
